procedure.method: Independent assessment in this fresh conversation, without spawning, forking or resuming. Read only the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, summarize.py, run_agent.py, declared ratio policy and five native-evidence manifests; verified their hashes and all 15 PNG hashes, byte sizes and dimensions. Five successive results displayed M1, M2, M3, M4 and M5 respectively, each in native, usage720, thumbnail320 order. All 15 displays were inspected before the first transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. The ordered viewed array binds these displays to packet pins. No OCR, contact sheet, image generation or editing was used. A later read-only PNG chunk check established 8-bit RGB with no tRNS for all native images, hence full opacity; the failed optional Pillow import performed no image inspection or write.
